text_block_list.name: Still in Love
Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(To lose track of time and... b-bask in...
such sheer bliss...!)
choice_data_list: Y-Your face is so red, do you have a fever!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
N-No...! I'm so sorry, I really...
I feel so terribly bad about this...
U-Ugh... I can't even look you in the eye...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still in Love seemed truly remorseful. It didn't seem to be a fever... In any case, I told her to be more careful in the future.
